title: Mihran Spah vs Procession of Ugarit
lede:
Mihran Spah won 37-18 on Victory Points at the end of Battle Round 5, holding the centre and the left objective from Round 2 to the end.

The Spah's charges destroyed two of the Procession's four Cultist Troopers in Round 2, and after that the Procession had only The Pontifex of Acedia's corner of the right flank to score from.
result_line: Mihran Spah win 37-18 on Victory Points in Battle Round 5
deployment: Central Faceoff on CROSSROADS, three objectives on row 7: the 3 VP centre at (7,7) and the 2 VP flanks at (1,7) and (13,7). Mihran Spah lined up along row 12 in front of its HQ at (7,13): Aswaran 2 on the left at (3,12), Shieldbearers 1, Sagdid Hound-Keepers and Javidan Immortals 2 beside it, the Mobad with Javidan Immortals 1 at (9,12), Shieldbearers 2 at (10,12) and the Spahbed with Aswaran 1 on the right at (11,12). Its Round 1 Troop Requisition added a second Sagdid Hound-Keepers at (8,12). The Procession of Ugarit set up on its home rows around the HQ at (7,1): Morphean Engine 1 at (9,0) and Morphean Engine 2 at (3,1), Hellkin at (6,1), three Cultist Troopers along row 2, The Pontifex of Acedia at (9,2), the Algedonic Taskmaster with the Cultist Mortar Squad at (11,2) and the Somniferous Engine at (11,1) carrying Cultist Troopers 1. The set-up gave the Spah fast cavalry on both flanks against a slow army whose guns would fire from home, and an army of ten-model Cultist squads that had to walk to the objectives. The Spah had Priority (fewer units on the battlefield, 8 to 10).

1.title: Both flanks to the Spah, the centre to the Cultists

feed.text: Primaries revealed: ERADICATE THE FOE for the Spah, BREAK THEIR HOLD for the Procession. Secondaries kept: MAN OF THE HOUR and BAR THE GATES. The Spah spent all 3 CP on Troop Requisition (Sagdid Hound-Keepers #2 at 8,12); the Procession spent its 2 on Double Time for Cultist Troopers 4.

Sagdid Hound-Keepers ran to 1,8 on the left objective; Aswaran 1 with the Spahbed (13,8) and Sagdid Hound-Keepers #2 (12,8) took the right. Cultist Troopers 4 used its Double Time to reach 12,6, inside the same Objective Area. The Pontifex of Acedia (8,6) and Cultist Troopers 2 (6,6) walked onto the centre, with Cultist Troopers 3 behind at 6,5; Javidan Immortals 1 and the Mobad reached 8,8, inside the same area. Hellkin headed for the left flank at 2,5.

Aswaran 1 shot Cultist Troopers 4 for 6 (20 to 14), and Tithe of Torment paid the Procession 6 Mana for it. All four of the Procession's guns missed: both Morphean Engines and the Cultist Mortar Squad at Javidan Immortals 1, the Somniferous Engine at Aswaran 1.

The Procession took the centre on OC 13 vs 11 (3 VP); the Spah took the left (OC 3 vs 0) and the right (OC 12 vs 7), 2 + 2. BREAK THEIR HOLD paid 1 for Cultist Troopers 4 standing in the right objective's area, and BAR THE GATES completed, +2. 4-6.

2.title: Two Cultist Troopers charged down, and a Pontifex appears on the right

feed.text: The Spah spent 2 CP on Secure Objective for Aswaran 1 and 1 CP on Double Time for Shieldbearers 2; the Procession 2 CP on Double Time for Cultist Troopers 3. Secondaries kept: PROBING STRIKE and MAN OF THE HOUR.

Shieldbearers 2 walked to 6,8 and drew three Overwatch volleys: Cultist Troopers 4 passed Desperate Worship (3 HP to itself) and put 4 into them, Cultist Troopers 2 one more, 10 to 5. Their own Overwatch burned 4 off Cultist Troopers 3. Hellkin charged Sagdid Hound-Keepers at 1,8; the hound-keepers broke away to 0,6 and Aswaran 2 charged Hellkin at 2,8. Aswaran 1 charged Cultist Troopers 4 and Javidan Immortals 1 charged Cultist Troopers 3. The Pontifex of Acedia, which stood at 8,6, attached to Cultist Troopers 1 inside the Somniferous Engine, which had just moved to 14,6.

Shieldbearers 2 used Alchemical Vial and shot Cultist Troopers 2 for 8 with BURNED. Aswaran 1 destroyed Cultist Troopers 4 in melee (11 damage) and Javidan Immortals 1 destroyed Cultist Troopers 3 (16). Hellkin attacked Aswaran 2 for nothing and took 8 back from the counterattack (20 to 12). Cultist Troopers 1 and the Pontifex disembarked at 14,7 and put 3 into Aswaran 1. Morphean Engine 1 hit Shieldbearers 1 for 6; Morphean Engine 2 hit Javidan Immortals 1 for 3 and its own Cultist Troopers 2 for 4 in the same blast. The Pontifex's Daemonium Meridianum on Aswaran 1 (3 Mana) failed its roll. PROBING STRIKE completed, +2.

The Spah took the centre (OC 13 vs 2) and the left (OC 9 vs 3), 5 VP, and ERADICATE THE FOE paid 3 for the two kills in Objective Areas. The right was a 13-13 OC tie that went to the Procession on units in the area, 2 VP, and BREAK THEIR HOLD paid 3 because the Spah had held it at the start of the round. 14-11.

3.title: Hellkin breaks away in disorder; three objectives, two owners

feed.text: The Spah spent 1 CP on Double Time for Sagdid Hound-Keepers #2 and 2 CP on Rally Cry for Shieldbearers 1; the Procession 2 CP on Rally Cry for Cultist Troopers 2. Both units passed. Secondaries kept: TERRITORIAL SUPERIORITY and DEEP REACH.

Hellkin failed its Fall Back test against Aswaran 2 and broke away in disorder to 5,4; Cultist Troopers 2 broke away from the Mobad to 5,3. Sagdid Hound-Keepers came back onto the left at 2,6, and Aswaran 2 rode from the left to 6,8, into the centre's area. Javidan Immortals 1 charged Hellkin at 6,5. Vessel of Agares held the Spahbed and Aswaran 1 still and denied a CHARGE.

The Pontifex cast Blood Sacrifice (2 Mana, 3 HP from Cultist Troopers 1) for +1 MS and +1 BS across the Procession. Morphean Engine 2 hit Aswaran 1 for 4 (9 to 5), and the Somniferous Engine POISONED Aswaran 1 and the Spahbed. Sagdid Hound-Keepers #2 and Aswaran 1 shot Cultist Troopers 1 for 5 and 3 (17 to 9). Javidan Immortals 1 put 9 into Hellkin (11 to 2). The Cultist Mortar Squad destroyed Sagdid Hound-Keepers #2. The Mobad spent 3 Mana on Ember of Atar for Aswaran 2, which bought nothing.

The Spah held the centre with Aswaran 2 alone (OC 6 vs 0) and the left (OC 3 vs 0), 5 VP; the Procession held the right on OC 8 vs 5, 2 VP. TERRITORIAL SUPERIORITY paid the Spah 3 and DEEP REACH paid the Procession 3. 22-16.

4.title: Aswaran 1 dies of poison; Cultist Troopers 1 burns

feed.text: The Spah spent 2 CP on Secure Objective for Aswaran 2 (it bought nothing) and 1 CP on Rally Cry for Aswaran 1, which passed; the Procession 2 CP on Double Time for Cultist Troopers 2. Shieldbearers 1, Hellkin and Cultist Troopers 2 failed Morale and were SUPPRESSED. Secondaries kept: ASSASSINATION and PROBING STRIKE.

Hellkin broke away from Javidan Immortals 1 to 1,3, and Javidan Immortals 1 stepped back onto the centre at 7,6 beside Shieldbearers 2 at 8,7. Aswaran 2 left the centre for 10,8. Javidan Immortals 2 walked to 12,7, into the right objective's area.

Morphean Engine 1 put 12 into Javidan Immortals 2 (15 to 3). The Spahbed's free weapon and Shieldbearers 1 set BURNED on Cultist Troopers 1 and the Pontifex, and with Aswaran 1's 2 the Troopers were down to 4. The Pontifex shot Aswaran 1 to 1 HP. The Mobad cast Sunburst (6 Mana) at 13,8, a BURNING FIELD beside the right objective with Javidan Immortals 2 inside it. POISONED destroyed Aswaran 1 at the end of the phase, leaving the Spahbed alone.

The BURNING FIELD destroyed Cultist Troopers 1 and took 1 HP each from the Pontifex and from Javidan Immortals 2. The Spah held the centre (OC 13 vs 0) and the left, 5 VP, and ERADICATE THE FOE paid 2 for the Cultist Troopers killed in the right Objective Area. The Pontifex alone held the right on OC 3 vs 2. 29-18.

The Spah spent 3 CP on Secure Objective for Sagdid Hound-Keepers on the left; the Procession 2 CP on Double Time for Cultist Troopers 2. Shieldbearers 2 and Cultist Troopers 2 failed Morale. Secondaries kept: DEEP REACH and KING OF THE HILL; MAN OF THE HOUR and PROBING STRIKE expired.

Hellkin charged Sagdid Hound-Keepers from 3,5, outside the left objective's area; the hound-keepers stayed. The Spahbed stepped to 12,6 beside the right objective and Aswaran 2 to 11,6; both Shieldbearers moved up to row 6.

Both Morphean Engines and the Pontifex fired at the Spahbed and missed. Sagdid Hound-Keepers and Hellkin traded melee attacks for nothing. The Mobad's Ember of Atar on Javidan Immortals 1 (3 Mana) bought nothing. BURNED took 3 more off the Pontifex (to 11).

The Spah's own BURNING FIELD destroyed the last of Javidan Immortals 2. The Spah held the centre (OC 9 vs 0) and the left (OC 6 vs 0), 5 VP; the right tied 3-3 on OC and 1-1 on units, no VP. DEEP REACH paid 3. 37-18, the Spah past 30.

analysis.title: Why it went this way
analysis.html:
Where the VP came from

Mihran Spah scored 24 of its 37 VP from objectives: the left flank in all five rounds and the centre in Rounds 2 to 5. ERADICATE THE FOE added 5 (3 for Round 2's two charge kills, 2 for Cultist Troopers 1 in Round 4) and three secondaries 8 (PROBING STRIKE 2, TERRITORIAL SUPERIORITY 3, DEEP REACH 3). The Procession of Ugarit scored 9 objective VP: the centre in Round 1 and the right flank in Rounds 2 to 4. BREAK THEIR HOLD paid 4, all of it in the first two rounds, and BAR THE GATES and DEEP REACH 5. It scored nothing in Round 5.

{{chart:objectives}}

What the key units did

The cheapest unit on the table did the most scoring. Sagdid Hound-Keepers (10 RP) held the left objective in four rounds and its share came to 9.8 VP, 8 objective VP that hinged on it, 97.5 VP per 100 RP. It broke away from Hellkin's charge in Round 2 and came back in Round 3. Aswaran 2 (6.5 VP) kept the left in Round 2 against Hellkin and then took the centre alone in Round 3. Javidan Immortals 1 did 25 damage, the most on the table, and Aswaran 1 22: their Round 2 charges took two full Cultist Troopers off the centre and the right. Shieldbearers 2 did 18 damage for 17 RP, from Overwatch and Alchemical Vial shooting.

For the Procession, The Pontifex of Acedia (6.8 VP) was its scorer: from Round 2 it held the right objective with Cultist Troopers 1 and then alone. Morphean Engine 1 was its best gun, 19 damage, 12 of them on Javidan Immortals 2 in one shot. Vessel of Agares held the Spahbed and Aswaran 1 still in Rounds 3 and 4 and Effluvium of Inanition cut the Spah's reach every round, but the Spah already stood on the objectives it scored.

{{chart:attrition}}

What the Procession could not do

Its OC was four ten-model Cultist Troopers, and the Spah's charges met them in the open. Two were destroyed in Round 2, the third (with the Pontifex beside it) burned in Round 4, and Cultist Troopers 2, SUPPRESSED from Round 4, spent the last three rounds being driven around its own half by Drive the Column and Double Time. Hellkin went to the left flank instead of the centre, lost 8 HP to Aswaran 2's counterattack, and stood in an Objective Area only in Round 2, outnumbered there 9 to 3 on OC. The Procession lost 30 RP to the Spah's 80, and still lost the battle by 19: it had the guns, not the bodies on objectives.

{{chart:rp-trade}}

The AI, not the army

  • Round 2, The Pontifex of Acedia: at 8,6 with MOVE 2 and no move recorded that round, it attached to Cultist Troopers 1 while that squad was inside the Somniferous Engine at 14,6, and disembarked with it at 14,7. That put the Procession's best scorer on the right objective six squares from where it stood; it scored 6 VP there. This looks like an engine fault, not a choice (see the report's problems).
  • Round 4, the Mobad's Sunburst: 6 Mana for a BURNING FIELD at 13,8 with the Spah's own Javidan Immortals 2 standing at 12,7. The field did 3 HP to enemies (it finished Cultist Troopers 1) and 3 to Javidan Immortals 2, which it destroyed in Round 5's Cleanup. It was standing in the right objective's area when the field killed it, just before that objective tied 3-3.
  • Javidan Immortals 2 (30 RP) took no action in five rounds, and Aswaran 2 made only one attack, a counterattack. Most of the Spah's idle rounds were "no legal action": nothing was in reach.
  • Secure Objective bought nothing in all three uses (7 CP): in Round 2 Aswaran 1's right objective was lost on the unit count anyway, in Round 4 Aswaran 2 rode off the centre after receiving it, and in Round 5 Sagdid Hound-Keepers had no enemy in its area.
  • The Procession's Mana: Tithe of Torment paid it 35 Mana, and it spent 5 (Daemonium Meridianum, Blood Sacrifice). It held 30 from Round 4 on while the Pontifex only fired its weapons.

The result looks like the army more than the AI: the Spah's cavalry and charging infantry beat cheap Cultist bodies to the objectives. The Procession's AI added to it by sending Hellkin against Aswaran 2 on the left, a fight it lost, instead of to the centre.

Against the first playing

The first playing also went to Mihran Spah in Round 5, 31-15. This time the Procession fielded four Cultist Troopers instead of one (the cheaper Pontifex and Morphean Engines paid for them) and scored objectives in four rounds instead of two, but the Spah won by more. The first playing's 8 VP from BREAK THEIR HOLD fell to 4, because the Procession now held ground instead of contesting it, and Tithe of Torment, which paid it no Mana in the first playing, paid 35. The Spah opened with Troop Requisition instead of the Double Time that ran Shieldbearers 2 into the guns and lost it in Round 1, and took 10 VP in Round 2 (the round cap) where it had scored 2.

closing: The Spah's cavalry and Javidan took the Cultist Troopers off the board in one round, and a 10 RP squad of hound-keepers held the left for the rest of the battle. The Procession's guns and auras hurt the Spah, killing 80 RP to the 30 it lost, but scoring needs units in Objective Areas, and by Round 4 it had one.
